competences.description: Attacks all enemies with 100% Critical Rate to decrease their Attack Power for 2 turns with a 75% chance and Defense for 2 turns with a 75% chance. If the enemy's Attack Power or Defense is already decreased, stuns for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
The target's defense will be increased by 70%.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Removes the bind to make the Lord of Hell disappear from the battle and Devil Maiden reappear. Upon reappearance, Devil Maiden gains a turn instantly, and the cooldown of [Bind: Lord of Hell] decreases by 1 turn.

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: Of [Bind: Lord of Hell] upon reappearance
